history.sg_progress: The Department of Peace Operations will convene a series of webinars with relevant missions to promote the existing monitoring and evaluation guidance for disarmament, demobilization and reintegration, as part of a result-based management approach and with a particular focus on impact and outcome measurement, including a guide on how to develop indicators. The Disarmament, Demobilization and Reintegration Section will also hold a dedicated meeting with the Integrated Disarmament, Demobilization and Reintegration Training Group to ensure further integration of the monitoring and evaluation sessions into the curricula and a stronger emphasis, where necessary, on ways to measure outcomes.
